Apple (AAPL) compounded revenue at 5.0% a year over 4 years. Did profitability keep up?

Latest fiscal year: FY2026 (ended Sep 26, 2026)
• Revenue: $478.8B (+15.1% YoY)
• Operating margin: 33.0%
• Net margin: 27.6%
• Free cash flow: $136.1B (28.4% of revenue)

4-year view (FY2022 → FY2026)
• Revenue: $394.3B → $478.8B (1.2x; compound annual growth 5.0%)
• Operating margin: 30.3% → 33.0% (+2.7 pts)
• Free cash flow: $111.4B → $136.1B
• Cash conversion: operating cash flow was 109.8% of net income
• Year that stands out: FY2023, operating margin 29.8%, revenue growth −2.8%
